A seafood dish that you can actually wolf down whole!|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Glazed Seafood is a dish that can be made by [[Cooking]] any [[Seafood]] together with [[Courser Bee Honey]]. The default variation can be made by using seafood that has a different effect than the Courser Bee Honey. When eaten, they will some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. Glazed Seafood is known to be a meal that can be eaten in one sitting. Only one variation of Glazed Seafood is available: * '''Energizing Glazed Seafood''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Glazed Seafood}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A seafood dish you can actually wolf down whole!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hyrule Bass]]es, [[Sanke Carp]], [[Staminoka Bass]]es, or [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s. Eating these [[Meal]]s will refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Glazed Meat * Glazed Mushrooms * Glazed Veggies * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
